name: NEXT
full_name: Neutrino Experiment with a Xenon Time projection chamber
summary: NEXT uses high-pressure xenon gas to combine precise calorimetry with two-electron track imaging. NEXT-White established the technology before NEXT-100 began taking data at Canfranc in May 2024.
detection_principle: Ionization electrons drift into an electroluminescence region. Photomultipliers measure energy and the initial scintillation time; silicon photomultipliers image the track, including enhanced energy deposits near both electron endpoints.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
